summary: Ceragon Networks Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing it has received and booked approximately $86 million in orders from operators in India year-to-date through May 5, 2026. The orders primarily involve its IP-50EXA platform and millimeter wave technology for Fixed Wireless Access (FWA) expansion. Approximately $24 million of these bookings were recognized as revenue in Q1 2026, with the remainder expected by end of 2026. This is a routine operational update on sales orders, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are mentioned. What to watch: execution on revenue recognition of remaining $62 million.
